cases.rationale: The bedroom contains a bed with pillows and quilt, a single desk chair, an open laptop with visible keyboard, and identifiable stacked books at the left. The desk is a work surface and the round bedside stand is not identifiable as a dining table. Small clear objects on the bedside stand could be a bottle and drinking cup, but their forms are too small to distinguish reliably from decorative objects; bottle and cup remain unclear. The small dark oval at the front left of the desk could be a computer mouse but lacks sufficient detail, so mouse is unclear. Framed pictures do not supply actual people or other depicted objects. All 75 definitions were individually considered over the whole crop.
